question: Show all pairs of entertainers and customers who each have up to three style strengths or preferences, where the first and second style preferences of the customers match the first and second style strengths of the entertainers (or in reverse order). Only return the entertainer’s stage name and the customer’s last name
sql:
WITH ent_first AS (
    SELECT EntertainerID, StyleID AS FirstStrengthStyleID
    FROM Entertainer_Styles
    WHERE StyleStrength = 1
),
ent_second AS (
    SELECT EntertainerID, StyleID AS SecondStrengthStyleID
    FROM Entertainer_Styles
    WHERE StyleStrength = 2
),
cust_first AS (
    SELECT CustomerID, StyleID AS FirstPrefStyleID
    FROM Musical_Preferences
    WHERE PreferenceSeq = 1
),
cust_second AS (
    SELECT CustomerID, StyleID AS SecondPrefStyleID
    FROM Musical_Preferences
    WHERE PreferenceSeq = 2
),
ent_count AS (
    SELECT EntertainerID
    FROM Entertainer_Styles
    GROUP BY EntertainerID
    HAVING COUNT(*) <= 3
),
cust_count AS (
    SELECT CustomerID
    FROM Musical_Preferences
    GROUP BY CustomerID
    HAVING COUNT(*) <= 3
)
SELECT 
    e.EntStageName,
    c.CustLastName
FROM Entertainers e
JOIN ent_first ef ON e.EntertainerID = ef.EntertainerID
JOIN ent_second es ON e.EntertainerID = es.EntertainerID
JOIN ent_count ec ON e.EntertainerID = ec.EntertainerID
JOIN Customers c ON 1=1
JOIN cust_first cf ON c.CustomerID = cf.CustomerID
JOIN cust_second cs2 ON c.CustomerID = cs2.CustomerID
JOIN cust_count cc ON c.CustomerID = cc.CustomerID
WHERE 
    (cf.FirstPrefStyleID = ef.FirstStrengthStyleID AND cs2.SecondPrefStyleID = es.SecondStrengthStyleID)
    OR
    (cf.FirstPrefStyleID = es.SecondStrengthStyleID AND cs2.SecondPrefStyleID = ef.FirstStrengthStyleID)
ORDER BY e.EntStageName, c.CustLastName
